'''2000 Naboo Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Naboo region (Eire, Scotland, U.K.) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00naboo">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=naboo 2000 Regionals: Naboo], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727135443/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=naboo Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Michael Riboulet]] of Bristol, England won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 4 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Harrier Public House 91 Bishops Rise Hatfield, Hertfordshire U.K.
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Peter Di Biasio]]
* '''Players:''' about 40<ref name="tr-d860" />

== Trandosite decklists ==

Trandosite published two decks from this event. Alex Tennet's page calls itself "a modified version of the deck Alex Tennet used in the 2000 Naboo Regional". Neil Goodacre's page says his deck lost all three games "at the Naboo Regional". It was captured in October 2000 and uses Third Anthology cards, so it is the 2000 event.<ref name="ds123">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds123.htm Search And Destroy], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001018023015/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds123.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="ds122">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds122.htm Agents In The Desert], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001028162121/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds122.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Decklists ==
Players posted these lists on DeckTech as decks they played at the event; the posted list may differ slightly from the one played.

* [[2000 Naboo Regionals Mike Kessling Take the Power Back-Naboo Regional]] ([[Mike Kessling]], [[Dark]]; 2nd) — "4-0 at the regional beating both Michael Riboulet and Gary Carman"
* [[2000 Naboo Regionals Mike Kessling The Unforgiven- Naboo Regional]] ([[Mike Kessling]], [[Light]]; 2nd) — "the deck I used at the Naboo regional"
